group.label: Memoirs · Journal of a Newbie Officer

lines.text: There's been some incredible news making the rounds in the military lately.
Apparently, a squad called Goddess has been taking down Raptures wherever they go.
I read the combat reports submitted to the higher-ups. Twenty operations in two weeks, with a 100% success rate.
Victory after victory. They haven't lost a single battle yet...
What's most surprising is that the Goddess Squad is being led by a human commander.
How can an ordinary human lead a unit on a battlefield where even Nikkes are being slaughtered?
After spending all day at headquarters and hearing nothing but grim reports of defeat, his existence comes as a breath of fresh air.
With his arrival, I'm beginning to see a glimmer of hope in this war that has relied solely on Nikkes.
